verdict.rationale: Mercury documents several built-in automations (AI-driven bill reading/auto-pay, auto-attaching receipts, automatic invoicing, AI-powered bookkeeping sync, auto-cashback) plus API/webhooks and a CLI that can be run from scripts or CI pipelines for background operations. However, the officially hosted MCP server is strictly read-only (31 get/list tools, no write actions), so autonomous agent-driven actions (payments, invoicing, transfers) require the API/CLI with manual credential setup rather than a turnkey agentic automation framework. Missing for 10: a documented way to schedule/trigger write-capable autonomous agent actions, a first-class automation/workflow builder, and independent evidence of end-to-end autonomous runs.
